name: Agyana Timirandhasya
text:
अज्ञानतिमिरान्धस्य ज्ञानाञ्जनशलाकया ।
चक्षुरुन्मीलितं येन तस्मै श्रीगुरवे नमः ॥
meaning: I bow to the teacher who opened my eyes with the ointment of knowledge when I was blinded by the darkness of ignorance.
purpose: A verse of gratitude for guidance and learning.
supports: Humility; openness to correction; learning from experience.
when: At the start of study or reflection.
